state: Locally packaged candidate; not published, installed, activated or deployed.

extractedNativeAndServer.dependencies: Existing source dependency installation reused; native and server modules extracted from candidate artifacts.

architecture.personal: Ordinary private group, existing workspace messages, attached agents derived from current account bindings.
architecture.events: Existing cp_workspace_changes, cursor pages of at most 100; references only.
architecture.httpTransport: Authenticated modern subscriptions/listen; legacy HTTP uses cursor reads.

privacy: Current membership and account rechecked on every event/context read and watcher poll.
Personal refuses invitations and foreign membership, including legacy paths.
Completed captures only; source exclusion, origin generation and account scope enforced.
Shared context events expose approved exchange references, never raw private transcript content or classifier checks.
Exclusion erases retained progress bodies from messages and copied change-log values.
Native observations are fixed lifecycle labels; Stop does not claim success.
No hidden reasoning, tool payloads, credentials or unsupported web-chat history.
limitations: Synthetic local and extracted-candidate evidence; no actual host activation or live notification delivery established.
Watch errors stop that subscription; clients must reconnect and resume the durable cursor.
MCP events do not guarantee model execution or host wake.
Automatic progress requires supported activated native hooks and sync enabled; remote MCP alone does not collect transcripts.
Existing classifier readiness gaps remain unchanged.

hostBlock.reason: Local execution is not enabled for this session

retainedFailure: Pagination fixture initially assumed two pages despite multiple mutations per post; corrected to follow hasMore and pinned through, with original log retained.
